extroverted.dialogue.chat: %1$s! Come here, I've been wanting someone to talk to all morning.
extroverted.dialogue.chat/1: Oh good, company! Sit, sit. I'll do most of the talking if you like.
extroverted.dialogue.chat/2: There you are! I was starting to think I'd have to talk to the chickens again.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations: A proper long talk? %1$s, you've made my whole day. Where shall we start?
extroverted.dialogue.conversations/1: Yes! Nothing better. I could do this until the sun goes down and then some.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations/2: Finally, someone who wants to actually talk. Go on, ask me anything.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.check: Wonderful! Market day was packed and I spoke to every single person there. I'm still buzzing from it.
Great week — full house at the inn two nights running. That's my idea of a good time.
Splendid, thanks for asking! Half the village stopped to chat this week. I keep count.
Quiet week, and quiet's the worst kind for me. Everyone's been indoors. I've been climbing the walls, honestly.
Lonely one, if I'm honest. You turning up has fixed most of it, %1$s.
You asked already! Not that I mind — ask me a third time, I'll happily answer.
Again? Delighted to repeat myself. Still good, still glad you're here.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.day.g: Marvellous day. Three conversations before noon and one of them turned into a proper argument. Wonderful stuff.
Busy and loud and full of people. Exactly how I like it.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.day.r: Nobody about all day. Not one soul at the well. I've been talking to myself since morning, %1$s.
Empty sort of day. The work was fine — it's the silence that got to me.
I love it! You meet everyone doing this. Half my friendships started over this work.
Very much — mostly because it puts me right in the middle of everything. That's where I like to be.
It's the alone part. Hours with nobody to talk to. I'd take twice the work for half the solitude.
Not the work — the quiet. I don't do well with quiet, %1$s.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.villa: %2$s! I know every single person here and most of their business. That's what makes it home.
Love %2$s. Can't cross the square without three conversations. Takes me an hour to fetch water. Worth it.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.peopl: They're the best part, %1$s! Every one of them's got a story and I intend to hear all of them eventually.
I adore them. Loud ones, quiet ones, difficult ones. Especially the difficult ones.
Anything at a crowded table. The food's secondary — it's the noise around it that I'm there for.
Whatever's being shared. I've never once enjoyed a meal alone and I don't intend to start.
Oh, you'll want to sit down for this one, %1$s — it's long and there are a great many people in it.
Where do I begin? Everyone I've ever met is in this story somewhere. Get comfortable.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.dream: A house that's always full. Doors open, table crowded, someone always arriving. That's my whole ambition.
To know everyone in the valley by name. I'm about a third of the way there, %1$s.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.fears: An empty village. Everyone gone, doors shut, nobody left to talk to. It frightens me more than it should.
Being left out. Hearing the laughter from the wrong side of a door. That's the one.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.feeli: I talk to everyone, %1$s — but I look forward to you. That's the difference, and it's a big one.
Of all the people I chase conversation with, you're the one I'd wait for. That's saying a lot.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.defle: Ha! I'll tell you everything about everyone else, but that one stays mine a while longer, %1$s.
I'm an open book with a couple of pages stuck together. That's one of them. For now.
Now that's a quiet question, and I'm not much good at quiet yet. Give me time and you'll get it.
I talk a great deal and say very little about that. Not today, %1$s. Someday.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.gossi: Nothing! Can you believe it? I've asked everyone. Dreadfully uneventful week.
Not a scrap of news, and believe me I've been looking. The village has gone boring on us.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.us.ha: Happy? %1$s, I'd tell the entire village if you let me. Actually, I think I already have.
Enormously. You're the conversation I never want to finish, and that's the truest thing I know.
extroverted.dialogue.conversations.gossi: %2$s and %3$s got married and I was there for every minute of it! Best day the square's had all year.
Have you heard? %2$s and %3$s wed! I've told nine people already and I'm not close to finished.
%2$s and %3$s have separated. Everyone's talking, of course. I've mostly been listening, for once.
Sad news — %2$s and %3$s parted. I've made a point of sitting with both of them separately.
%1$s, I'm sorry — %2$s has passed. The whole square went silent. I've never heard it like that.
We lost %2$s. I've spent the week making sure nobody's grieving on their own.
%2$s has been born! I've met them twice already and I'll be back tomorrow. Wonderful news.
New arrival, %2$s! Half the village has been round. I organised most of that, I'll admit.
%2$s moved in! I introduced myself before they'd unpacked. They'll be one of us in a fortnight.
We've a newcomer — %2$s. I've already had them round for supper. Lovely person.
%2$s has left for good. I organised the send-off. It was a good one, but I'll miss them badly.
%2$s moved away. One fewer familiar face at the well. Those gaps don't fill easily, %1$s.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Sorry, sorry — say that again? I was still talking.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: Didn't catch it! Once more, louder.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.hint: Ooh, ask me about %2$s. I could go on for hours.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.shrug: No idea — but I know three people who would!
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.shrug/1: Couldn't say! Let's go ask someone.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: %2$s or %3$s? Actually, both. But start with one.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.dropped: I've talked myself right off the topic. Where were we?
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.dropped/1: Lost it! Too many words. Remind me?
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.busy: Two minutes! I'm mid-conversation and it's a good one.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Hold that thought — literally, hold it.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.muted/1: Not a word. This is very hard for me.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: Bye, %1$s! Come back and tell me everything.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Off already? Fine, fine — but we're finishing this later!
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.insult: Oh, that's not how we talk to each other here.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.insult/1: Hey now. I'd rather we stayed friends.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.hail: %1$s! Come here, I've been saving up things to say.
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: There you are! Sit, sit — how are you?
extroverted.dialogue.chatmode.hail/2: Oh good, someone to talk to!
